display_name: Zuora: List SQL Data Query Jobs
description: List SQL Data Query jobs (GET /query/jobs), optionally filtered by query_status (submitted, accepted, in_progress, completed, failed, cancelled) and sized by page_size. Zuora returns one response with no continuation; completion's pagination says whether the response filled page_size (may_have_more) and how to see more. Returns job_id/status queued at once; dispatch is not completion.
embedding_description: List Zuora SQL Data Query jobs on the tenant, optionally only those submitted, accepted, in progress, completed, failed or cancelled, with the page size Zuora returns. Use it to find recent query jobs, their result files, or stuck jobs to cancel.

result_processor_customizations.action_label: Zuora SQL data query jobs listed
result_processor_customizations.result_description: Queued job envelope. Completion carries operation, method, path, status, correlation_id, data (Zuora's data array) and pagination {page, next_page (always null: no vendor continuation), returned, page_size, may_have_more, hint}; may_have_more true means the response filled page_size, so filter by query_status or raise page_size.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Queued is not completion. On completion relay HTTP status, ids and states exactly as Zuora returned them; a write or delete may have changed vendor state, so do not replay it automatically. Credential values never appear; [REDACTED] marks where Zuora echoed one.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: List SQL Data Query jobs (GET /query/jobs), optionally filtered by query_status (submitted, accepted, in_progress, completed, failed, cancelled) and sized by page_size. Zuora returns one response with no continuation; completion's pagination says whether the response filled page_size (may_have_more) and how to see more.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: zuora.invalid_params is input that does not match Zuora's documented shape or an output/input path outside export_allowed_roots (zuora.export_path_refused). zuora.permission_denied is the vendor's 403 for the registered OAuth client's role, with Zuora's reason. zuora.object_not_found, zuora.validation_failed (vendor 4xx), zuora.query_failed (Data Query 4xx), zuora.rate_limited and zuora.api_error map Zuora's answer; zuora.auth_failed is a 401 credential failure.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Correct the parameters, or ask the Zuora administrator to grant the OAuth client's role the needed Workflow, Data Query or Files permission. Read current vendor state with the matching get or list verb before retrying a write. Back off on rate limits.
